plan.scope: Warm whole resolver with active native damage sharing, status transplantation, splash and their combination. Actor life/status/text reset and read-only hit/RNG counters are timed equally. Snapshots, IPC and explicit GC are outside timing. Fixed simulation clock; no per-frame/world update or physical-device claim. Retained heap is not allocation volume.

interpretation.kind: Measured desktop characterization; optimization acceptance remains open
interpretation.interpretation: The new boundary has mixed active-workload medians, from 4.12% faster to 5.37% slower than the immediate predecessor. Identical current-build controls range from 2.71% faster to 4.70% slower between worker slots. These controls demonstrate variation, not a confidence interval or a correction factor. Splash at 64 actors is slower in all twelve rounds, making it a specific follow-up concern. No causal speedup, allocation reduction, whole-frame or target-device improvement is claimed.

followUp.next: Confirm the splash cost in an isolated repeat, profile original/predecessor/current active resolver paths and allocation sites, then accept a refactor only if behavior and comparative measurements remain sound.

limitations: Single desktop comparison and separate identical-input control, no cross-run confidence model
